scope_guards: The structured 46-home capacity is retained once and is not added to the broader 87-home scheme.
The broader 87-home application is not silently substituted for the structured record without exact polygon binding.
The 2021 Section 73 variation is the same 87-home permission lineage and is not additive.
One hundred percent affordable is a tenure characteristic of 87 homes and not additional capacity.
Lease, loan and disposal decisions are delivery/asset evidence rather than exact title mapping or extra homes.
Anticipated practical completion in 2025 is not treated as exact completion after the 2026 contractor-administration update.
Contractor administration and replacement procurement do not change dwelling capacity or permission scope.
No score or promotion is written without exact current geometry, title relation, completion status and executed overlays.
